title: Traditional Norwegian Kjottkaker
description: A hearty and flavorful Norwegian meatball dish often served with potatoes and vegetables. This recipe serves four and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, flour, bjor, onion, egg, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
3. Use your hands to shape the mixture into small meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter.
4. Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch (2.5 cm) of space between each meatball.
5. Bake the meatballs in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
6. While the meatballs are baking, toast the flatbread slices in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
7. Serve the meatballs with toasted flatbread and your favorite sides, such as potatoes and vegetables.
